explanation: OEIS A100434 conjectures c(n) + d(n) = g(n) + a(n) with g(2n) = 0, g(2n+1) = c(2n+1). The formal statement g(n) + a(n) = b(n) uses the sign-corrected b, equivalent to the OEIS chain given c + d = b (checked numerically for n < 38). Faithful to the intended statement; severity 2 for the phrasing through the corrected b.
